require 'webrick'
require 'ipaddr'
require 'fluent/engine'

module Fluent
  module RPC
    class Server
      def initialize(endpoint, log)
        @bind, @port = parse_endpoint(endpoint)
        @log = log

        @server = WEBrick::HTTPServer.new(
          BindAddress: @bind,
          Port: @port,
          Logger: WEBrick::Log.new(STDERR, WEBrick::Log::FATAL),
          AccessLog: [],
        )
      end

      def parse_endpoint(endpoint)
        if m = /\A\[([^\]]+)\]:(\d+)\z/.match(endpoint)
          bind = m[1]
          port = m[2].to_i
          begin
            IPAddr.new(bind)
          rescue IPAddr::InvalidAddressError
            raise Fluent::ConfigError, "Invalid rpc_endpoint: #{endpoint}"
          end
        elsif m = /\A([^:\[\]]+):(\d+)\z/.match(endpoint)
          bind = m[1]
          port = m[2].to_i
          unless valid_bind_address?(bind)
            raise Fluent::ConfigError, "Invalid rpc_endpoint: #{endpoint}"
          end
        else
          raise Fluent::ConfigError, "Invalid rpc_endpoint: #{endpoint}"
        end

        unless (1..65535).cover?(port)
          raise Fluent::ConfigError, "Invalid rpc_endpoint: #{endpoint}"
        end

        [bind, port]
      end

      def valid_bind_address?(bind)
        begin
          IPAddr.new(bind)
          return true
        rescue IPAddr::InvalidAddressError
          # Hostnames are allowed (e.g. "localhost"), but wildcard addresses
          # such as "*" are not valid for rpc_endpoint.
          !!(bind =~ /\A(?:[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?)(?:\.(?:[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?))*\z/)
        end
      end
